interface.signature: def palindromepair(arr: list[str], N: int) -> bool:

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, str) for x in arr) and 1 <= N <= 20000 and all(1 <= len(x) <= 10 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: The input `arr` is a list of strings where each string has length between 1 and 10, and `N` is the size of `arr` (1 ≤ N ≤ 20000).

postconditions.expression: any((arr[i] + arr[j] == (arr[i] + arr[j])[::-1]) for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)
postconditions.description: Returns `True` if and only if there exists a pair of distinct strings `arr[i]` and `arr[j]` (i ≠ j) in `arr` such that their concatenation `arr[i] + arr[j]` is a palindrome.
